rows.note: Use 改善 as the all-purpose choice for making a situation, quality, or result better.

example.english: This method can enrich the quality of the service.
example.traditional: 呢個方法可以改善服務質素。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 ho2 ji5 goi2 sin6 fuk6 mou6 zat1 sou3

rows.note: Use 提升 when the emphasis is on raising a level, standard, quality, or value rather than improving it generally.

example.english: Training can enrich employees' professional skills.
example.traditional: 培訓可以提升員工嘅專業水平。
example.jyutping: pui4 fan3 ho2 ji5 tai4 sing1 jyun4 gung1 ge3 zyun1 jip6 seoi2 ping4

rows.note: Use 豐富 when making life, content, knowledge, or experience richer by adding variety or substance.

example.traditional: 旅行令我嘅生活更加豐富。
example.jyutping: leoi5 hang4 ling6 ngo5 ge3 saang1 wut6 gang3 gaa1 fung1 fu3

rows.note: Use this construction specifically when making a person or group financially richer.

example.english: This job can enrich me financially.
example.jyutping: zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1 ling6 ngo5 jau5 cin2 di1
